messages:
maya: dropped a new frame for threshold controls + notification preview. main question: numeric input + slider combo or slider-only for quick adjustment?

ben: slider-only feels fast but we lose precision. combo (slider + small editable number) seems like best of both worlds. keep both in compact rows.
carlos: agree on combo. when rows get dense, the number can collapse into a pill that expands on focus. saves vertical space.
emily: preview concern: when multiple channels are configured, the preview panel grows tall. Can we collapse inactive channels by default? maybe show top 3 + "show more".
maya: thinking "top channels" based on notification priority. defaults to highest priority.
dave: accessibility/contrast nit: suppressed badge colors currently use low-contrast gray — hard to read for low-vision users. bump contrast and add an icon.
a11y-bot: Suggestion: follow WCAG contrast >=4.5:1 for text within badges. Also include an aria-hidden icon plus meaningful aria-label like "Email channel, snoozed until 16:00".

ben: copy debate: internal panels use "mute" historically. product wants "snooze". devdocs uses "suppress". which do we standardize?
emily: user research favored "snooze" in tests. it's friendlier and maps to existing calendar metaphors.
carlos: technical caveat: "snooze" implies temporary. if we support indefinite suppression, label should clarify "Indefinite snooze" or fallback to "mute".
maya: proposal: primary label "Snooze"; tooltip/ARIA: "Snooze (suppress notifications) — click to choose duration". keeps clarity and accessibility.

dave: keyboard flow: when you open per-route preview with focus shortcut (P), focus lands in the search filter. good, but pressing Tab should cycle to first threshold control, not skip into the preview list. confirm DOM order.
a11y-bot: Focus order should follow visual order. Use tabindex=0 on the first interactive control. Also ensure 'show more' expands with aria-expanded state.

emily: layout idea: compress channel rows by moving the icon left, then threshold controls, then microcopy. Add a subtle divider between channels for scanability.

maya: quick microcopy suggestions: 1) "Add threshold" -> "Add alert threshold"; 2) "Suppress" -> "Snooze"; 3) "Preview" -> "Notification preview".

b\u200ben: small point: in compact view, we should hide the long description under a disclosure toggle, not inline. many users ignore it and it takes space.
carlos: dev note: if we lazy-render hidden descriptions we save a lot of DOM cost. +1 for performance.
dave: with summary header for the preview panel, we can have a concise status line: "3 channels, 1 snoozed" — that also helps screen reader users get the gist.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: make the summary an ARIA role=region with aria-live=polite when statuses change. Use short messages: "One notification snoozed". Avoid repeating for each row.

maya: decisions: slider + editable number; collapse descriptions; show top 3 channels with "show more"; summary header with polite live; use "Snooze" primary copy, aria clarifies state. i'll upload updated frames by EOD and tag for another quick pass.
emily: can you add a token-cost note near preview? some PMs asked to correlate thresholds with expected noisy alerts / cost implications.
maya: noted. will add a small inline tooltip "estimate: low/medium/high".

dave: thanks. timeline ok for me. tagging engineers for sync after updated frames. :sparkles:
